title: Sienese envoys to the Priori and Capitano del Popolo of Siena, before 1429 (ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 14, DECODE R4802)

documents.shelfmark: ASSi, Concistoro 2308, fasc. 2 "Lettere in cifra", no. 14 (DECODE R4802)

transcription.notes: point-divided words; year unknown: Carlo Malatesta alive (<=1429); 1420 is a placeholder within c.1409-29

system.summary: Italian simple substitution with a few homophones (e = TR, 2; o = 6, P; i = Q4, PD, L; a = EQ, Q, TL), word points kept, and a few code signs for persons and a number (<7H>, <Z7>, (420)).

diacritics.note: bars on o; arcs mark nasal abbreviation

system.notes: Before 1429 (Carlo Malatesta alive). Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 14 only.

prior_solution.where: Not in print or online (Meister 1902, Cecchini 1952, Senatore 2009 checked); the 1952 inventory calls the bundle 'solo parzialmente decifrate'

conditions.human_role: Set the goal (decipher the 29 letters; try the 42 filed keys first). Instructed that DECODE records marked Decrypted are to be trusted as read.

solution.what: Found the whole busta Concistoro 2308 on DECODE (keys R4746-R4789, letters R4790-R4814, R1858), missed by the 23 Sept scan; downloaded 131 images with the project cookie (the session that worked on all the Concistoro letters).
Viewed and indexed the 43 key records of fasc. 1 (R4746-R4789); compared their alphabets by eye with this letter's signs: none fits.
No. 14 (R4802) transcribed by a subagent: ~1,300 tokens, 248 point-divided words; re-checked to split the sign OBAR into OL/OR/O after key work showed it stood for both d and m.
wordsolve.py (spaced it-cinquecento LM, order 4/5, 10 x 300k) on no. 14 without cribs: stuck on pseudo-Italian.

Hand crib on the recurring words '8 6 RR IB VB Q' = nostra/vostra, 'RR IB EQ IB 6' = stato, 'Y 6 RR IB VB' = vostr-: re-anneal gives Italian ('del nostro stato e dela nostra cita', 'considerano', 'carlo', 'toscana').
homsolve2.py (staged order 3->4 anneal, frequency-seeded restarts, swap moves) on no. 14 with NO crib reaches the same key and better score (-3991 on the corrected transcription).
No. 14 dating: Carlo Malatesta (1368-1429) alive; war of Tuscany with 'three powers' against <Z7>; not fixed (1409-14 or 1423-24 candidates).

Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 14 only. Fraction taken from the second reading pass (transcripts/no14_reading2.txt: 876 of 1,495 tokens in words read as sense); validation rerun on no. 14 alone.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 845 tokens, 35 types, it-cinquecento order 4: reading -2.153 per letter; random keys -3.953 (z 6.1); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.793 (mean -2.828, z 29.9); annealer on the real text -2.659. Verdict: pass.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): transcripts/no14b.txt (revised transcription) and no14_signs.tok; readings no14_reading2.txt (second pass) and no14_reading.txt; key key14.txt

Reading audit (George Lasry's sentence test, 22 Oct 2026): no14_reading.txt read line by line. L01-L06 build Italian sentences with bracketed words (reviewed B); from L07 nearly every line has unread runs, queried words and code signs, so the rest is split off as decoded, not read (35% of sentences clean in docs/_check_reading.py). fraction_read 0.586 -> 0.28 (tokens in the lines that read).

Re-read b34: DECODE R4802 re-fetched (no attachment); L07-L26 written out from the second pass as transcripts/no14_L07-L26_reading.md with English; scored 0.048 plain, 0.143 explicit holes; look-alike classes (Q/Q4, 8/TH, P/PHI) carry the doubtful words, above the 3% limit. L07 compared on the full-size image: no sign resolves further. Kept decoded, not read.

Verify v8: L01-L06 running text (transcripts/no14_L01-L06_reading.md) scored with v2_score.py: 0.0 explicit holes (0/7), hole rate 0.289; doubtful words in every sentence. Back to decoded, not read; no line reads: class not read, method not solved (key recovered ciphertext-only as a part), fraction_read 0.

texts.label: Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 14 (DECODE R4802), before 1429: lines L01-L06
texts.summary: Sienese envoys on a journey to the Priori and Capitano of Siena: they arrived safely, and report Domenico's two hours' talk with a servant of <7H>, the friend's word that Carlo Malatesti and others share the same jealousy, Tuscany united with the three powers, and war with <Z7>; <7H> is at Naples. Key recovered ciphertext-only; the second reading pass (no14_reading2.txt) marks doubtful and unread words.
